shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; cat package.json; sed -n '120,155p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; git status -sb"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts | head -25; cat tsconfig.json; ls scripts/spec-links'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts');s=p.read_text().replace('  private readonly ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});','  private readonly ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});\\n  private readonly dynamicValidators = new WeakMap<object, ValidateFunction>();');s=s.replace(\"    log.info('tool', 'executing', {name, inputKeys: Object.keys(input)});\", \"    if (typeof tool.definitionSource === 'function') {\\n      const schema = tool.definitionSource().inputSchema;\\n      if ("'!this.dynamicValidators.has(schema)) {'"\\n        this.dynamicValidators.set(schema, this.ajv.compile(schema));\\n      }\\n    }\\n    log.info('tool', 'executing', {name, inputKeys: Object.keys(input)});\");p.write_text(s)
p=Path('.lore/dod.md');s=p.read_text().replace('- [ ] Cache compiled validators for function-valued', '- [x] Cache compiled validators for function-valued');p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts');s=p.read_text().replace(\"        {\\n          const lastMessage\", \"        const lastMessage\").replace(\"          const content = lastMessage.content;\\n          firstRoundToolResult\", \"        const content = lastMessage.content;\\n        firstRoundToolResult\").replace(\"          yield {\\n            type: 'tool_use',\\n            toolCall: {id: 'call-2', name: 'get_weather', input: {location: 'Paris'}},\\n          };\\n          yield {type: 'stop', stopReason: 'tool_use'};\\n          return;\\n        }\\n      },\", \"        yield {\\n          type: 'tool_use',\\n          toolCall: {id: 'call-2', name: 'get_weather', input: {location: 'Paris'}},\\n        };\\n        yield {type: 'stop', stopReason: 'tool_use'};\\n      },\");p.write_text(s)
PY
 timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "head -30 CHANGELOG.md; npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md; rg -n \"it\\(|test\\(\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'inputSchema' src/types/ai.ts; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md');s=p.read_text().replace('registry.test.ts#L5)', 'registry.test.ts#L7)').replace('registry.test.ts#L17)', 'registry.test.ts#L19)');p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m 'Cache dynamic tool schema validators' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
